ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant high-intensity (white) central region accounting for approximately 85% of surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pigmentation along the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across central lobes; black pigmentation localized to the entire trailing edge boundary and leading edge tips; dark focal spots located in the upper-left quadrant (approx. 3 clusters) and upper-right quadrant (approx. 4 clusters); dark linear streaks localized to the bottom-central region near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 92 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced, irregular peaks and valleys with a significant notch located in the outer distal third.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave sweep along the trailing edges of both lobes; leading edges exhibit a convex curvature transitioning to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured white/grey clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; scattered dark circular spots (pitted scarring) visible on the interior white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark diagonal linear marks on the lower left lobe and a prominent dark vertical line extending downwards from the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on distal tips; irregular tissue loss (notching) along the trailing edges, particularly on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive, narrow vertical dark pigment line originating at the apex of the median notch and extending toward the ventral peduncle area.
